description: This source file contains a comprehensive test suite for the 'git grep' command, specifically focusing on the recurse-submodules feature. It includes setup of repository structures, submodules, various grep scenarios (patterns, pathspecs, nested submodules, submodule moves, partial clones, etc.), validation of configurations and edge cases, and handling of specific features like textconv and refs. The file also tests interactions with submodules and the superproject in different states.

methods.name: reset_and_clean
methods.description: Resets the repository state to a clean state, removes untracked files, and recursively resets and cleans all submodules.
